snapshot.note: The study directory was not in any commit when validated (staged by another session during validation). Every file this certificate names is bound by sha256; the eks-results files are byte-identical to the S3 originals written by the worker (validation/provenance.txt). A commit of the study directory must carry these hashes.

independence.replayer: Validator subagent (claude-opus-5-5), separate from the producer session; re-executed every measured run of both sessions into new receipts under validation/; producer receipts untouched (replayed on byte-identical copies)
independence.statement: Cross-binary, cross-host replay: the worker measured with ecbench 583e62f0 (image, source cb2ec6873f30) on c8a.2xlarge (env ECBENV2h3a51beea0bc2); the validator replayed with ecbench bf5eec6d on env ECBENV3h13e37662a118, and all 1440 measured runs of each session reproduced identical counts. Every recovered scalar of every measured run re-verifies [d]G = Q under the validator's own affine arithmetic. Not an independent implementation of the IC pipeline.

command: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 2 <replay_binary> verify --dir <copy of P<b>/eks-results/session> --replay-all --exit-code --out validation/replay-P<b>.audit.json

independent_scalar_check.method: validation/recompute.py: curve coefficients derived from plan.json points; p, r prime; all points on the curve; [r]G = O; r the only multiple of r in the Hasse interval (so #E = r); j-invariant equal to the ICV1 string; [d]G = Q in affine coordinates for every measured record of every arm
